critical_code_review_comments: ColorCodeNameInput (MultiCategoryConfiguratorDialog.jsx:19-33) is a clean, reusable code+name pair with data-invalid attribute and inline required message — matches PO spec.
deriveColorMode() (line 41-47) correctly re-derives mode from persisted color_internal/color_external so line-edit round-trips are stable across reloads.

multi-cat-confirm disabled logic (line 409) depends on preview.pricing_status==='ok' — this is the ONLY guard against submission with an empty code because the UI shows COLOR_CODE_REQUIRED inline but the backend can silently reply pricing_status='ok' when color_mode falls back to WHITE_MASS. Consider adding a client-side guard: disabled if any visible cfg-color-*-required is present, defense-in-depth.
PDF preview correctly redacts internal labels (STANDARD/SPECIAL/WHITE_MASS/+10%/BIANCO_MASSA/NON_STANDARD) — customer-facing invariant intact.

quote total math: subtotal is post-discount, discount_amount is reported separately, VAT applied on subtotal, total=subtotal+vat. This is correct but the field name `subtotal` may be confusing to API consumers — consider renaming to `subtotal_net` or documenting it in the API schema.
